title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the Sprinters Stakes. On our way to Nakayama Racecourse…

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan! Good luck in today's race!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, everyone. ♪ I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna steal everyone's hearts! ♪ Don't miss it!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Sooooo adorable!
Erupting cheers envelop us.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha. That was crazy. People were even calling out to me at the racecourse. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's like I'm at the center of all the excitement. I loooove it! ♪
I do feel like there's more excitement around her than before. Or maybe her fans have just changed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Running in this atmosphere is totally gonna make me cuter!
choice_data_list: I wonder what caused the big change.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's because of my "Let's Go! ♪ Summer Training" series! I take it you haven't checked it out yet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's because of my "Let's Go! ♪ Summer Training" series! I take it you haven't checked it out yet?
"Let's Go! ♪ Summer Training" is a series she started on her "Curren Channel ♪" on UmaTube recently.
As the name suggests, it's a special new series she made about summer camp and her daily training, a slight departure from her normally cutesy channel.
I've been watching every video as soon as they're uploaded, but…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, if you watched them right away, you probably didn't notice. I guess you totally are my number one fan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, if you watched them right away, you probably didn't notice. I guess you totally are my number one fan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All right, let me explain! The fifth video in the series, "Cute Continent," is probably the best example.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… One more!

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is exhausted. Still, she grits her teeth and continues to push herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wanna get even faster. I'm gonna keep on running so I can keep getting better!

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text: Trainer: Why do you try so hard?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I guess… to be the me I wanna be. I want everyone to see me at my cutest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Plus, sprints are super fun! I hope that by watching me, everyone can get into them.

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text: Just what does Curren Chan have planned as she strives to master cuteness?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes starts at 3:40 p.m. at Nakayama Racecourse. Come see how serious I can be!

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Racecourse. Curren's home away from home.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! I think I did a good job on the editing. Take a look at the views for the series.
"Cute Continent" seems to be doing particularly well and has a lot of comments. Among them…
"Her resolve is amazing." "I didn't care for her much before, but I might be a fan now."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This one says, "Curren Chan's a runner to watch in this year's Sprinters Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The training series was actually pretty tough for me… but it sure looks like it paid off!
choice_data_list: You really struck a chord with everyone.
You really struck a chord with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Totally seems like it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Until now, I pulled people in on pure charisma, and I always thought that was fine…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But that wasn't enough for the people who wanted something more dramatic. I had to show them the story I'm weaving.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's just like before—I did an interview, answered questions, and people read about it. I need to do that again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's not that I myself need to change. I just need to change how I do things. Right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's not that I myself need to change. I just need to change how I do things. Right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I've changed the minds of racing lovers on UmaTube. I'd call that a great success. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All right! Now all I've gotta do is win! I can't waste all this attention I've gotten for myself by losing!
Curren Chan is exuding self-confidence. If she can keep this up, the Sprinters Stakes will be no problem. Or at least, that's what I'd like to think.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, then. Good luck today, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Flower's so cute.
Nishino Flower. A talented runner who looks to be Curren Chan's biggest obstacle in today's race.
choice_data_list: Yeah, she's really pleasant and adorable.
Yeah, she's really pleasant and adorable.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean. She's… too cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Did you know they call her the "Bento Fairy" on Umatter?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The bento boxes she makes are super cute and nutritious. She only recently started posting pics, but she's already one of the top accounts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Her level of cuteness has already earned her… 4.35 million followers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This race isn't gonna be as easy as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But still! I'm different now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I've gotta go show everyone I'm the cutest one here today. ♪
